architecture.mechanism: Real-time, continuously streaming MA-rPPG monitoring using standard webcams with multimodal sensing and conversational AI integrated into an interactive platform to deliver ambient, low-interruption interaction and real-time user feedback.
architecture.intervention: Adapt the continuous-streaming, low-interruption sensing-and-feedback architecture to the engine start-stop controller: an in-cabin sensor (microphone, camera, or vibration/breath sensor) continuously streams occupancy/driver-engagement data while the engine is running. A timer-counter running in parallel tracks elapsed idle time. When a pre-set maximum idle period is reached and no driver-presence or active-control signal has been detected during the interval, the controller commands the engine control unit to shut off the engine, then issues a conversational or audible prompt (e.g., push-to-restart or auto-stop notification) consistent with normal start-stop and remote-start user experience.
architecture.expected_effect: Engine auto-shuts off after the maximum idle period if the driver has left the vehicle or is not engaged, eliminating unintended prolonged idling, while preserving ordinary key-off, start-stop, and remote-start sequences because driver presence and standard control inputs are detected as real-time signals that reset or inhibit the auto-shutoff.
architecture.falsification_test: On a representative 2021 Outback XT (or equivalent start-stop/remote-start vehicle) instrument the system to log idle duration, driver-presence/control-input stream, and engine state. Run 30 trials of (a) intentional remote start with no driver approach, (b) normal parking with driver exiting and door closed, and (c) driver remaining seated but silent. Pass criteria: engine shuts off within 5 seconds of the maximum idle threshold only in scenario (a) and (b), and never in (c); remote-start and standard start-stop operation must be unaffected on subsequent ignition cycles. A failure is any unintended shutoff during active use or any continued idling beyond the threshold when the driver is absent.
